title: Zephyrine and the Verdict
author: Juniper Dunmore
blurb: Zephyrine Sterling, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
